epistemic_status: DESIGN OR IMPLEMENTATION ANALYSIS of a documented prospective-capture defect. Isolated branch only. This lane does not block possession research unless it changes the historical feature evidence.

defect.summary: The forecast-coverage auditor admits records that were created after their own cutoff as evidence that the forecasting job was healthy at that (slate date, decision-time label). Such records are classified `late_record` and are deliberately excluded from SERVED, yet they still downgrade an unserved obligation from `missing_job_did_not_run` (operational miss) to `missing_data_unavailable` (benign game-specific gap).

site.note: The file is UNTRACKED. `git ls-files prospective_pair/` returns nothing and no commit touches it. It does not exist on branch player-model-program. Read read-only; nothing was written to that worktree.

reproduction.method: Re-derived the served-evidence index from the frozen published audit frame and re-applied the classification rule with a timeliness test. No re-run of the auditor (its main() writes into the repo-root worktree).

affected_obligation.published_reason: job served 2 other game(s) on 2026-08-03 at T-30m

fix.rule: A record counts as evidence the job was healthy at a label only if it was created at or before that label's cutoff — the same predicate as the late_record test. Timeliness that cannot be established (unknown tip or unknown label) excludes the record: fail closed toward reporting the miss.
invariants_verified: only missing_data_unavailable can change class, and only to missing_job_did_not_run
coverage_served is invariant under the fix
late_record rows keep their own classification
evidence never leaks across dates or decision-time labels
an operational miss is never demoted to a data gap
fails closed when tip or label is unknown
